newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's BBAG buys stake in Romania's Craiova.
newsitem.headline: Austria's BBAG buys stake in Romania's Craiova.

text.p: Austrian drinks group BBAG said on Tuesday it had acquired a 47 percent stake in Romanian brewery Craiova.
The group, which already has wide-ranging interests throughout eastern Europe and controls most of the Austrian beer market, did not provide any financial details of the deal.

Following the acquisition, annual production at Craiova -- Romania's second largest brewery -- would be raised to 600,000 hectolitres from 527,000 currently, BBAG said in a statement released ahead of a news briefing.
"Taking a stake in this brewery will enable BBAG to increase its share of this interesting growth market to about 10 percent," it added.
The group already owns Hungarian breweries Sopron and Martfu, Starobrno in the Czech Republic and Arbema in Romania.
BBAG last month reported a 69 percent jump in 1996 pretax profit to 1.304 billion schillings on group sales of 10.17 billion schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
